answer.text: The manual does not give a weight in kilograms for the panniers or top box.
It says you must not exceed the maximum payload set out in the GMA fitting instructions for panniers and top boxes.

policy.text: Do not exceed the maximum payload defined in the GMA fitting instructions for panniers and top boxes.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not state the maximum payload in kilograms; check the GMA fitting instructions or confirm with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.
